title: Proto shield v.5 - hole-by-hole layout (2026-10-20)
Top view, the Uno's USB end on the LEFT, digital headers at the top. Hole = ROW/COL.
notes: Grid read off Evan's photos (2026-10-20). Rows: T top rail; P1 P2 plain; U1-U3 upper 3-hole strips (cols 1-10); G GND rail; V 5V rail (= the Uno 5V = the Pi's USB); L1-L3 lower strips; P3 P4 plain; B bottom GND rail = the STAR (Evan's choice).
Cols 1-10 = the ten short strips counted from the USB end; 11-13 = plain holes right of them; 0 and negative = the plain field left of the strips.

MEASURED by Evan 2026-10-20 (shield off the Uno): T, V = 5V header pin (beep); G, B = GND header pin (beep); G-B beep; neighbouring strips silent; the Uno pins reach the shield only through their own sockets. Step 0 re-checks the two items not yet metered: U1/1-U3/1 beep (one strip) and V-G / V-B silent.
Uno connections are Dupont male pins plugged into the shield's own sockets (Evan). Off-board cables use 0.1 in male headers (Evan).
The 470 uF for the LED strips goes AT each strip's input pads (+5V / GND), not on the shield - that is where the WS2812B guidance puts it.
The TB6612 VM bulk cap C1 (470 uF) and C2 (0.1 uF) are soldered across the carrier's VMOT and GND pin tips on top of the carrier.
DIN_L / DIN_R: the D4 (left strip) / D7 (right strip) Dupont wires each carry 200 + 200 ohm soldered in series inside the wire (heat-shrunk). KEY = J5's pulled pin, no connection.

copper.name: G and B joined by the shield's GND traces (Evan metered 2026-10-20: beep)

labels.text: Power / analog headers below this edge

parts.note: Orientation: put a marker dot on the PWMA pad (label side), flip chip-up, dot at the TOP-LEFT. Top row = control, bottom row = power.
Encoder yellow (A) and white (B) do NOT go here: give them male Dupont pins and plug them straight into the D2 / D3 sockets.
W9 VBAT, (key), W14 +5V2, W12 pack - (motor return).
Put the Dupont female-female jumper (or a jumper cap) on the TOP two pins (UNO5V + SERVO_V) = servo on the Uno 5V (Evan, JR). Move it to the bottom two = servo on +5V2 (fallback).
Servo plug: orange/white = SIG at the top, red in the middle, brown/black = GND at the bottom.
Body lies over G/9 and V/9 - leads go ONLY into L1/9 and U3/9.

offboard_parts.note: + lead (no stripe) to the VMOT pin tip, - lead (stripe side) to the GND pin tip next to it, at the right end of the carrier's bottom row.
Same two pin tips as C1; no polarity.

wires.note: VMOT to the VBAT strip, insulated, hops over L3/8
TB6612 GND to the star rail, hops over P3/8 and P4/8
TB6612 VCC to the Uno 5V - ROUTE: left along row L3, then up column 0 (never under the carrier)
+5V2 to JP1's bottom pin - ROUTE: left along row P4 under the J1 pins, then up to P3/-1
servo GND to the star - ROUTE: left along row B, then up to P3/-2

direct_uno.note: male Dupont pin on the cable end, straight into the D2 socket
male Dupont pin on the cable end, straight into the D3 socket

steps.title: 0. Remaining meter checks BEFORE any solder (shield OFF the Uno, continuity mode)
do: Already done by Evan 2026-10-20: T and V beep to 5V; G and B beep to GND; G beeps to B; neighbouring strips silent.
0.1 U1/1 to U3/1: must BEEP (one strip, three holes)
0.2 V/12 to G/12 and V/12 to B/13: must be SILENT
If either differs, STOP and send me the result.

steps.title: 1. TB6612 headers and carrier-top work (off the shield)
do: Solder the two 8-pin headers to the carrier: SHORT ends up through the carrier, LONG ends down.
Mark PWMA (label side) with a dot.
On the carrier's top, solder insulated wire bridges between the pin tips: PWMA-PWMB, AIN2-BIN2, AIN1-BIN1 (any thin wire), AO1-BO1 and AO2-BO2 (22 AWG).

Solder C1 (470 uF): + lead to the VMOT tip, stripe (-) lead to the GND tip next to it (bottom row, right end); stand the can UPRIGHT on the two tips, leads short (Evan 2026-10-21; was: lay it flat). Bend C2's leads out past the carrier's bottom edge, low, so C2 sits beside the can, not under it.
Solder C2 (0.1 uF) across the same VMOT and GND tips.
steps.check: meter: PWMA-PWMB, AIN1-BIN1, AIN2-BIN2, AO1-BO1, AO2-BO2 each BEEP; VMOT-GND does NOT beep (C1 may chirp once)

steps.title: 2. Carrier onto the shield
do: Chip up, dot at the top-left: top row pins into U2/1 ... U2/8, bottom row pins into L2/1 ... L2/8.
Solder all 16 on the underside; trim the leftover pin length.
steps.check: U1/1 beeps to the PWMA pin; L3/7 beeps to VMOT; L3/1 beeps to L3/8 (GND through the carrier)

steps.title: 3. Bottom-side solder bridges (each joins exactly two neighbouring holes)
do: Motor outputs: L3/3-P3/3, L3/4-P3/4.
DANGER: P4/5 (GND) and P4/6 (+5V2) are neighbours - they must NOT touch.
VBAT strips: L2/9-L2/10.  Strip data: L3/12-P3/12, L3/13-P3/13.
Uno 5V to the left field: V/1-V/0, V/0-V/-1, V/-1-L1/-1.
DANGER: P3/-1 (+5V2) and P3/-2 (GND) are neighbours - must NOT touch.
steps.check: P4/5 to P4/6 SILENT; P3/-1 to P3/-2 SILENT; P4/6 beeps to P4/13; V/12 beeps to L1/-1

steps.title: 4. Headers
do: J5 (4 pins, pull out the 2nd pin) in L3/10, P3/10, P4/10, B/10.  J6 (1 pin) in B/11.
steps.check: J5 top pin (L3/10) beeps to L1/9 (the VBAT strip; VMOT joins it only with w1 in step 6); J3 middle beeps to J4 middle (+5V2); J3 bottom beeps to B/8

steps.title: 5. Divider
do: R100k lying flat: leads into L1/9 and U3/9 only (body over G/9, V/9).
R10k standing: U2/9 and U2/10.  R2k standing: U3/10 and G/10.

steps.title: 6. Top-side jumper wires (insulated 22 AWG)
do: w1 L3/7 -> L3/9 (VMOT to the VBAT strip).
w2 L3/8 -> B/8 (TB6612 GND to the star).
w3 L3/2 -> V/0 (TB6612 VCC to the Uno 5V).
w4 P4/7 -> P3/-1 (+5V2 to JP1's bottom pin).
w5 B/2 -> P3/-2 (servo GND to the star).
steps.check: J5 top pin (L3/10) now beeps to VMOT (through w1); VBAT (L3/10) to B/10 SILENT; V/0 to B/2 SILENT; P4/7 to B/2 SILENT

steps.title: 7. Dupont wires to the Uno sockets (cut a male-male jumper, solder the cut end in the hole)
do: L3/12 -> D4 and L3/13 -> D7, each with 200 + 200 ohm soldered in series IN the wire, heat-shrunk.
Encoder yellow -> D2 socket, white -> D3 socket (male pins on the cable, not through the shield).
steps.check: with the shield on the Uno: each socket pin beeps to its hole; the Uno's 5V pin beeps to V/12

steps.title: 8. Before the first power-up
do: Re-run every SILENT check from steps 0, 3 and 6.
Jumper on JP1's TOP two pins (servo on the Uno 5V).
Pack OFF (rocker), Uno on the Pi's USB first; then rocker ON with nothing else plugged in and meter VBAT at J5 (~8 V) and +5V2 at J3 middle (~5.0 V).
steps.check: VBAT ~ pack voltage, +5V2 ~ 5.0 V, Uno 5V ~ 5 V and NOT tied to +5V2 (V/12 to P4/13 silent with the power off)
